item.title: CookieRun: Crumble's mercs go broke, and need to Crumble Clash in new seasonal event
item.description: CookieRun: Crumble and its much cuter, smaller-scale version of the classic CookieRun: Kingdom world is one which seems to have enthralled fans. At least, that's the indication you get with the launch of CookieRun: Crumble's biggest update yet, and the introduction of Crumble Clash, which offers brand-new PvP action arriving November 19th (or, well, tomorrow)! Crumble Clash sees your humble mercenaries once more down on their luck, despite their (and your) best efforts. Fortunately, there are ways to get out of the problem, mainly by hiring on part-time workers for a brand-new hare-brained scheme that will see you duking it out with other players! ... [MORE]

item.title: CookieRun: Kingdom sees Shadow Milk Cookie face off against Boucheael Cookie in new update
item.description: With its sprawling storyline and many different characters, it should be no surprise that CookieRun: Kingdom is so popular with players. Now, its epic narrative enters a new chapter, as the recently introduced Shadow Milk Cookie faces off against Boucheael Cookie within the Cathedral of the First in the Sanctum of Revelation storyline. Yes, it's a particularly grandiose storyline for what is, at its core, a game about anthropomorphic baked goods. But for fans of Shadow Milk Cookie, a hotly anticipated addition in the previous update, it's just more of what they want that's arriving today. But, it's not just Shadow Milk Cookie's exploits to watch out for, as there're other major additions in this update. ... [MORE]

item.title: Dragon Ruins II offers you bare-bones, rock-hard dungeon-crawling action, now in pre-registration on Android
item.description: Nowadays, the quintessential fun of a dungeon crawl is virtually unknown to the younger generation. What happened to the times when starving to death or getting lost forever was a very real occupational hazard for adventurers?! Well, that's what Dragon Ruins II seeks to recapture as it opens pre-registration on Android. As the sequel to the original Dragon Ruins, in Dragon Ruins II you'll return to the capital city of Isigwere, taking on quests from its inhabitants as you venture deeper into the dungeon. All with the ultimate aim of slaying the dragon that lurks therein and becoming the much-vaunted Legendary Hero. ... [MORE]
